name: Kelvex MagRail Platform Operator Day Rig
description:
A sharp, functional uniform built for long platform shifts and passenger-facing visibility. The core is a structured navy poly-cotton jacket with reinforced elbows, a mandarin collar, and a Kelvex transit authority patch stitched in gold thread over the left breast — the corponation logo embroidered in the same gold running along the right sleeve cuff. Beneath it sits a moisture-wicking charcoal base layer with a half-zip neck, comfortable for sixteen-hour rotation. The trousers are deep navy with a pressed center crease — Kelvex issues them pre-creased via thermal shaping — with two cargo pockets on the thighs secured by snap flaps and subtle safety-orange reflective tape running the outer seams. A rigid belt with a stamped utility clip holds a fare-scanner holster and a folded emergency protocol card pouch. The boots are the Veldtmann Steelcap 7, standard-issue, in black with a slip-resistant tread rated for wet platform surfaces.

A Kelvex-branded navy cap with a stiff brim and ventilated crown completes the look. Neural port covers are provided as an optional accessory — small navy discs that snap over standard BCI ports to maintain the uniform's clean appearance during passenger interaction. The entire rig is aug-compatible at the collar and sleeve, with magnetic seam detachment along the left shoulder for wearers with chrome arm rigs. Everything reads crisp from fifteen meters: this is someone who represents a company, who keeps the trains moving, and who has exactly zero patience for fare evasion.
functionality: Platform-rated slip-resistant soles, fare-scanner holster, emergency protocol card pouch, BCI port covers for uniform compliance, aug-compatible shoulder magnetic seam, thermal-creased trousers for shift-long presentation, moisture-wicking base layer for extended wear
what_it_says: You work for a corponation. You're not proud of it exactly, but you're not ashamed either — it's a paycheck with dental, and you show up on time. There's a particular dignity in the pressed crease and the polished cap that says: I maintain standards even when no one's watching. Transit operators who've been at it a decade have theirs perfectly broken in; new hires wear theirs too stiff.
price_range: Φ180–Φ240 (typically issued, replacement parts purchased individually)
story_hooks: A platform operator notices a passenger boarding with a stolen transit chip — the same chip registered to someone who disappeared from the system three weeks ago.
The uniform's embroidered patch is a point of pride for some and a target for others — anti-Kelvex protesters have started marking operators they consider collaborators.
An operator discovers that the neural port covers issued this quarter contain a passive data-collection chip — someone is harvesting BCI metadata from every worker who snaps one on.

physical_description.visual_profile: Sharp, authoritative uniform silhouette with military-adjacent formality. Broad shoulders from structured jacket; tapered waist via fitted base layer; commanding presence from mandarin collar and peaked cap. Reads as institutional, trustworthy, and deliberately visible from distance.
physical_description.fit: Tailored but not restrictive — jacket sits close to the torso with articulated elbows for platform movement; trousers have precision press crease and sit flat at the hip; base layer compression-fit at torso, loose at shoulders for mobility.
physical_description.primary_material: Navy poly-cotton blend jacket (70/30 synthetic-natural weave); moisture-wicking charcoal synthetic base layer; deep navy thermal-creased trousers in performance blend; black slip-resistant Veldtmann rubber-soled boots.
physical_description.texture: Jacket fabric has subtle matte finish with reinforced ballistic weave at elbows; base layer shows fine ribbed texture; trousers maintain sharp factory crease; boots show grippy tread pattern and scuff-resistant coating.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep navy as dominant color (jacket, cap, trousers); charcoal base layer; black boots; gold-thread embroidery on breast patch and sleeve cuff; safety-orange reflective piping along outer trouser seams.
physical_description.closures: Jacket: six-button front with snap-together magnetic reinforcement at lower buttons. Base layer: half-zip neck. Trousers: concealed magnetic closure at fly, snap-secured cargo pocket flaps on thighs. Belt: rigid stamped utility belt with friction-lock buckle. Cap: adjustable rear snap closure.
distinctive_features: Gold-thread embroidered Kelvex Transit Authority patch (left breast)
Gold-thread corporate logo running along right sleeve cuff
Fare-scanner holster and emergency protocol card pouch attachments
Safety-orange reflective tape on outer trouser seams
Magnetic seam detachment along left shoulder (aug-compatible for chrome rigs)
Neural port cover snaps (optional navy discs included)
Thermally pre-creased center crease on trousers
Veldtmann Steelcap 7 boots with wet-surface slip-resistant rating
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3 — corporate-issued functional; not luxury, but legitimate corpo employment with equipment budget.
physical_description.cultural_context: Wearer is Kelvex Transit Authority staff, frontline public-facing worker. Signals reliability, institutional authority, and professional competence. Commands respect on platform; marks wearer as part of the megacorp transit infrastructure.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine on first day; broken-in after one shift; develops scuff marks on boots and minor wrinkles despite thermal creasing; uniform is regularly cleaned and re-pressed by corpo laundry service.
